en.title: Gold BJJ Aeroweave Jiu Jitsu Gi - Ultra Lightweight BJJ Gi - Preshrunk Brazilian Jiu Jitsu Uniform for Men
bullets: 40% Lighter Than a Standard Pearl Weave Gi: Our 275gsm Aeroweave gi will be your favorite lightweight gi. This ultra light gi feels incredible and won't leave you drenched after tough training.
As Strong As It Is Light: Your first reaction at a gi this light is probably, "how durable is it?" Nearly bombproof, thanks to reinforced stitching.
Slick Aesthetic: Available in five colorways with minimalist branding.
10oz Ripstop Pants: Ultra light and more breathable than traditional cotton gi pants: ripstop is the future. No one wants to be squeezing sweat out of their (or your) uniform 30 minutes into class.
Looking For a Womens or Kids Gi? We offer womens' cuts and kids' sizes of our Aeroweave gi on separate listings, just search: "Gold BJJ Women's Aeroweave Gi" or "Gold BJJ Kids' Aeroweave Gi"
